independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the gap between choices (vertical and horizontal) and the row pitch (shared with the radio group).

intent: Choose any number of options from a small set, with one value list for the set
Check or clear a set at once with a parent checkbox

properties.description: Form field name; the group submits name=value once per checked value (the checkboxes inside need no name).
Disables every checkbox inside (they read the group's isDisabled) and submits nothing. An ancestor <fieldset disabled> or ui-fieldset[disabled] has the same effect.
At least one value must be checked to submit (valueMissing on the group).

The checked values (null before the first render, then a list), a string[] in the order they were checked (attribute: space-separated). Setting it checks those checkboxes and clears the rest, without an event.

Base UI defaultValue: the values at first render (when no value attribute set them) and after form reset (attribute: space-separated). Without it, the value attribute, else the checkboxes authored checked, is the default.
Base UI allValues: every value the parent checkbox sets (attribute: space-separated). Default: the member checkboxes' values.
vertical: one checkbox per row, 1u apart. horizontal: a wrapping row, 4u between checkboxes.
Accessible name (aria-label) when no visible label names the group: prefer a ui-field label or a ui-fieldset legend.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between checkboxes in u (0…8 in 0.5 steps), along the group's direction; default 1u vertical, 4u horizontal.

events.name: input
events.detail: { value: string[], reason: 'none', event: Event } (Base UI onValueChange)
events.trigger: the user checks or clears a checkbox, or the parent checkbox (press or Space)

events.name: change
events.trigger: the user checks or clears a checkbox (same moment as input)

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Runs validation; fires invalid when it fails.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Marks the group touched (errors show) and reports.

methods.name: setCustomValidity
methods.description: Sets an author error; an empty string clears it.

semantics.formValue: name=value for each checked value (FormData); nothing without a name or a value

keyboard.action: moves through the checkboxes (each is a tab stop)
checks or clears the focused checkbox (the parent: every value or none)

content.children: ui-checkbox children (each with a value), optionally one with parent; they may sit in wrappers. Other content is laid out with them.

constraints: The group owns the value array: it sets its checkboxes' checked state from value; a press or Space on a checkbox adds or removes that checkbox's value, and the group (not the checkbox) fires input and change.

A checkbox with parent is checked when every value of allValues (default: the members' values) is checked, mixed (aria-checked=mixed, data-indeterminate) when some are; activating it checks every value, or clears them all when all were checked.
Its checkboxes are the ui-checkbox descendants whose nearest ui-checkbox-group is this one. Give the group the name; the checkboxes submit nothing.
disabled reaches every checkbox (a checkbox's isDisabled reads the group). required: invalid (valueMissing) until a value is checked.
Contains no native form elements; form participation goes through ElementInternals (UIFormElement).

React: CheckboxGroup (a single part, as in Base UI) renders a div role=group; its Checkbox children are native checkboxes that take the group's name, checked state and disabled from context (a parent Checkbox has no name); onValueChange(values, { reason: 'none', event }); allValues for the parent (default: the members, registered on mount); render and className (a string or (state) => string) apply to it.

avoidWhen.when: Exactly one option may be chosen.
avoidWhen.reason: A checkbox group holds any number of values.
One checkbox (or a switch for an instant setting) needs no group.

avoidWhen.when: Filtering by tags in a toolbar.
avoidWhen.reason: Selectable chips are the compact form for filters.

props: render?: RenderProp // Replace the part's element (Base UI render): an element (the part's props merge into it) or `(props, state) => element`. The recipe class and data-* stay on whatever renders.
className?: string | ((state: PartState) => string | undefined) // Author class, or a function of the part's state (Base UI className); added after the recipe class.
name?: string // Form name of the checkboxes: each checked one submits name=value.
defaultValue?: string[] // The first values when uncontrolled, and the reset value.
onValueChange?: (value: string[], details: ChangeDetails) => void // The user toggled a checkbox (Base UI onValueChange; reason 'none').
allValues?: string[] // Every value the parent checkbox sets; default: the member checkboxes' values (they register on mount).
required?: boolean = false // At least one value must be checked to submit (shown on the group).
orientation?: 'vertical' | 'horizontal' = 'vertical' // vertical: one checkbox per row; horizontal: a wrapping row.
variant?: 'list' | 'card' = 'list' // list: choice rows; card: each choice is a card surface holding any content (plan pickers, rich choices).
label?: string // Accessible name when no Field label or Fieldset legend names the group (aria-label).
size?: number // Unit u in px for the group and its checkboxes.
